counting_convention: identified = raw candidate-record mentions before merging duplicate re-surfacings across different queries. duplicates_removed = documented instances where the same underlying paper was independently re-surfaced by more than one query and merged into a single record (see SEARCH_LOG.csv notes for each instance; this is a conservative, explicitly-documented count, not a claim of exhaustive detection of every silent duplicate across 62 total queries). screened = identified - duplicates_removed = the count of unique individually-adjudicated candidate records, which equals PAPER_LEDGER.csv data rows (accepted_core + accepted_supplement + unresolved) plus EXCLUSIONS.csv data rows (excluded). full_text_checked = screened minus the title/abstract-only-stage exclusions that were screened out before any WebFetch attempt (E03, E04, E05 — two USPTO patents and one repository-only item with no publisher/DOI, carried from the pilot); equivalently, full_text_checked = accepted_core + accepted_supplement + unresolved + the exclusions reached at the full_text_verification stage. This convention extends the pilot's FLOW.json method to the full run's cumulative totals; the pilot's own 8 accepted + 11 excluded records are carried unchanged into PAPER_LEDGER.csv and EXCLUSIONS.csv and are therefore already included in the totals below (not double-counted separately). One disclosed cross-run exception: EXCLUSIONS.csv row E10 and PAPER_LEDGER.csv row P0031 refer to the same underlying paper (10.3390/s24186071) — excluded in the pilot for an HTTP 403 access failure, now accepted this run via a PubMed Central mirror not previously located. Both records are retained for audit continuity; E10's row is annotated as superseded rather than deleted, and P0031 is counted once in accepted_core (E10 is not separately re-counted as a new duplicate in duplicates_removed).

notes: FULL-RUN corpus for B12_lit_search. 62 unique publications retained in PAPER_LEDGER.csv (P0001-P0062), all accepted_core (verified peer-reviewed journal research or review articles with an opened publisher landing page or authoritative open-access mirror when the publisher domain blocked access, and a confirmed DOI); no accepted_supplement or unresolved item was retained this run (no conference-proceedings candidate had its venue's specific peer-review process independently confirmed to the standard required for accepted_supplement, so none were promoted). Every accepted or supplementary item was checked for correction/expression-of-concern/retraction status directly on its opened landing page or PMC mirror record; one correction (not a retraction) was found and disclosed on P0012 (Nat Commun 12:554, 18 Jan 2021), item retained as accepted_core per LIT_POLICY (a correction is not a retraction). Recency: 42 of the 62 accepted_core items were published 2020-2026 (hall_metrology 7, hybrid_diagnostics 10, hts_quench_current 10, power_conversion 15), exceeding the >=16-overall and >=2-per-stream gates. Seminal older items are present in every stream (hall_metrology 1996; hybrid_diagnostics 2001; hts_quench_current 2013/2015/2016; power_conversion 2019). This is a support-stage evidence corpus: no startup ranking, novelty claim, or synthesis is made anywhere in these outputs; that is reserved for B15_lit_synth (Fable/xhigh).
